text: When an ECP5 decimator's critical path runs from the DSP P-register through an 8-way fabric sum into a 21-cell accumulator carry chain, narrowing acc_width to the legal minimum 29 bits and registering the sum tree cuts 46 LUTs and lifts Fmax 13.2 MHz (105.4→118.6) by removing one carry cell and shortening its route.

On ECP5 decim with a DSP-registered fabric-pipe accumulator already timing-limited by psum LUT4 routing plus carry propagation at 118.55 MHz, do not widen the accumulator from 29 to 30 bits: it added 3 carry-chain cells and 0.49 ns of LUT route, dropping Fmax to 113.71 MHz (-4.84 MHz) with +1 LUT and no DSP change, so pipeline or retime the reduction path instead of increasing width.

When an ECP5 decimator is timing-limited by the DSP-output-to-fabric psum route into the accumulator, changing pipe_mul from 1 to 2 adds a second fabric register after the multipliers, cutting that LUT4 route from 4.07 ns to 3.11 ns and raising Fmax from 113.7 MHz to 121.3 MHz with unchanged LUT/DSP counts.

When an already-feasible ECP5 decimation MAC is timing-limited by the psum routing into the 22-cell carry chain (3.11 ns route + 1.14 ns carry route), do not cut acc_width 30→29 and add a third pipe_mul stage for LUT savings: it saved only 1 LUT and cost 0.85 MHz (121.26→120.41 MHz) because the extra pipeline stage did not shorten the dominant psum path.

On ECP5 decimator at 120.4 MHz with the critical path routing a registered DSP output through a 6-cell psum LUT4 (1.37 ns logic + 2.96 ns route) into a 22-cell carry chain, advancing pipe_mul to [3,2] only retimed the path to 122.3 MHz (+1.9 MHz) with LUT/DSP unchanged at 799/8, so do not rely on multiplier pipelining alone; reduce the psum reduction/carry-chain depth instead.

When the ECP5 decimator is feasible at 122.3 MHz with the critical path already DSP-pq→psum-LUT4→carry-chain (8.18 ns, routing-dominated) and LUT is stuck at 799, do not remove the supposedly off-path input register for area: it leaves LUT/DSP unchanged but reroutes the carry chain and adds 0.16 ns, dropping Fmax to 119.9 MHz and losing feasibility.

When an ECP5 decimator's DSP-registered output is routing-limited by an unregistered 8-way fabric sum feeding a carry-chain accumulator (105.4 MHz), enable sum_tree, set acc_width 30->29, and set pipe_mul 1->2 to register the reduction and shorten the psum route, raising Fmax by +16.9 MHz to 122.3 MHz while cutting 46 LUTs and keeping 8 DSPs.
